question: How many of the supplied section-size matrix claims follow from each declared rune-to-number representation, and how often do the same exact lengths occur among contiguous page intervals?
rune_rule: Keep only the 29 exact GP rune characters from data/index.json, including headings; discard punctuation, whitespace and other symbols. Decimal digit counts use unpadded base-ten values and concatenate before taking length.
intervals: All 820 contiguous, nonempty page ranges [first,last] with 0 <= first <= last <= 39, without a page-15 header exception.
special_cases: The page-15 17x17 claim excludes the first printed rune header line. The proposed page-10 printed 7 is not a rune and is not added to any stream. The suggested 16 red-rune exclusion on pages 23-26 is arithmetic only: color membership cannot be verified from these text files.
interpretation: An exact area is a representation-length identity, not a tested route, decryption, statistical probability or evidence that the section break was authorially selected.
